about: Hand-labelled sets for bench/eval_sets.py. Labels only, no footage: clips are 1280x720 10 fps segments of a public fixed-camera gym walk-through (scratch: yt/segs/<clip>.mp4 + <clip>-config.json). Labelled by looking at per-zone crop strips (2 s, then 0.4-0.5 s around sets) and ROI motion traces. 'who' is the lifter's body centre (fractions of the frame) at time t; the eval credits a set correctly when the credited track is the track nearest that point. 'reps_tol' widens the +-1 check where the count is uncertain (set already running when the clip starts, or slow/unclear reps). 'ignore' = stretches of a zone we could not label confidently; predicted sets that fall mostly inside them are not scored. Only zones in 'zones' are scored; others (far background) are unlabelled.
